title: Header parsing allocates lowercase String per line on hot paths
description: PER-LINE ALLOCATION ON INGESTION AND READER HOT PATHS — has_header (ingestion.rs:250), parse_message_id_and_newsgroups (pipeline.rs:524), and extract_overview (overview.rs:214) each call to_ascii_lowercase() producing a new String for every header line scanned. A typical article has 10-20 headers; this generates 10-20 transient heap allocations per article per scan. extract_overview runs at POST time; has_header loops over 5 mandatory headers (5 full scans). Fix: use a case-insensitive byte comparison (eq_ignore_ascii_case or manual byte comparison) to avoid the lowercase allocation entirely.
